rationale: The agent executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) and then stated the exchange was processed and a $16.85 charge would be applied to PayPal without first confirming the action or the payment method with the user, violating the policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication beyond looking up the user by email was not evident, and the final price difference statement was not clearly supported by visible tool results. While the agent appeared to act on the correct order and used relevant tools, the lack of required confirmation before the write makes this a fail.
